decisions.reason: Under 3.1 and 3.1's templates rule, citation templates are those 'whose purpose is to format a citation' (the guide's examples are not exhaustive: 'and similar'). The template {{EI2}} at cp 2278 is a transclusion (its template page is not a red link) and its rendered output in the li cite_note-EI2-4 is a CS1 citation ('<cite class="citation encyclopaedia cs1">', 'The Encyclopaedia of Islam, Second Edition (12 vols.). Leiden: E. J. Brill. 1960–2005.'). So d4 has a citation template and is not unstructured. AMBIGUITY: the guide does not name EI2; I read 'purpose' as the test, which the render confirms. The locked notes recorded uncertainty; the decision here resolves it.

The engine's unstructured unit at the same location (cp 2278, {{EI2}}) is not an item under the guide: unstructured is true only when the definition cites in plain text with no citation template (3.1). Because {{EI2}} is a citation template by purpose (item 0), d4 is not unstructured, so the locked label correctly has no such unit.
